quest.title: The Sun Rises Once More
quest.description: The sun will always pierce the darkness and shine hope down...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Why, of course. I owe you both my thanks — this lighthouse looks a fair sight better now that it's being maintained.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, our pleasure! Although, it seems like even with a functioning lighthouse, this whole place is still really dark. There are some places the light doesn't even reach.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Indeed. In the graveyard, it seemed as if even time itself had forever paused at the close of the battle that night.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I never had any intention of changing this, but it seems that by lighting the lighthouse, you have set time in motion once again.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: If you mean to ask whether I shall be inconvenienced in any way, the answer is no.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Life comes in cycles. Even without us, the ghosts that linger here would slowly disappear and return to the Ley Lines.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: So do not worry that this lighthouse cannot shine upon every last corner of the island. As the ghosts gradually leave, so too will the fog that envelops the area.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Oh, don't apologize, I am not against the change.
